title: P2 permanent vertical completeness gates
summary: Replace handler-existence coverage with a field-level semantic capability contract enforced in CI.
description: Field-level capability manifest; persistence/read/mutate/load/UI parity declarations; generated contract assertions; explicit exceptions with rationale; audit reporting and contributor guidance.
goals: Make future partial, unreachable, or cross-harness-inconsistent capabilities fail CI before release.
nonGoals: Replacing behavioral tests with static metadata
risks: A manifest can become another stale source unless tied to executable tests
Legitimate harness-specific differences need explicit bounded exceptions
completionCriteria: Every human-owned canonical field has declared and tested read/mutation surfaces
Every attested read proves the corresponding data was delivered
Documented capabilities have an executable end-to-end path
CI rejects undeclared parity drift and false-success contracts

tasks.title: Build a field-level semantic capability manifest
tasks.description:
Replace count-only assumptions with a canonical test-owned manifest mapping each persisted human-owned field and operation to core read/write, Pi, MCP, HTTP, Web UI, agent-load, documentation, and behavioral-test coverage. Encode system-owned and intentionally harness-specific exceptions with explicit rationale.

---
**Completion summary:**
Added test/field-capabilities.mjs as the canonical field-level semantic capability manifest. It declares human-owned project, feature, phase, task, requirement, and idea fields across core/Pi/MCP/HTTP/Web UI/agent-load/docs/behavioral-test surfaces, with explicit exceptions for derived, removed, and planner-owned fields. Added executable manifest validation regressions; both tests pass and diff check is clean.

tasks.title: Enforce vertical parity contracts in CI
tasks.description:
Generate or drive executable assertions from the semantic capability manifest so CI fails when a field is persisted but unreachable, attested but omitted, mutable in only one required harness, documented without an implementation path, or returns false success. Integrate with test/matrix-consistency.test.mjs and existing coverage gates.

---
**Completion summary:**
Integrated the field capability manifest into test/matrix-consistency.test.mjs. CI now validates semantic operation declarations, cross-harness parity keys, agent-context coverage, and continued false-success/no-op inventory coverage alongside the existing surface/scenario matrix. Field manifest and matrix consistency suites pass 15/15.

tasks.title: Publish and maintain the product capability audit
tasks.description:
Add contributor documentation and a generated bounded audit report that classifies capabilities as complete, partial, unreachable, harness-specific, deprecated, or exempt. Ensure generation is deterministic, links to owning tests and planner tasks, and cannot silently declare completeness from handler existence alone.

---
**Completion summary:**
Added deterministic capability audit generation via scripts/capability-audit.mjs with complete/partial/harness-specific/deprecated/exempt classifications, concise --check diagnostics, JSON/Markdown --write output, and an explicit rule that handler registration cannot establish completeness. Added docs/capability-audit.md contributor workflow, package test:capability-audit script, and canonical verify:final integration. Deterministic audit regressions and diff check pass.
